title: The dog that rode a wire 2,000 feet down #Shorts
description:
A logger strung fifty thousand feet of wire up Zion's east rim, and according to the Park Service a family dog named Darkey once rode it two thousand feet down. A dog could do it. A car could not.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 3: The Impossible Tunnel): https://youtu.be/30zzYRt_Mgk

#Shorts #Zion #History #NationalParks
